title: Why pendulums keep time
hook: A weight on a string kept the world on time for 300 years.
oneBreath: A pendulum swings at a steady beat set by its length and gravity, which is what made accurate clocks possible.

ideas.title: What sets the beat
ideas.oneLine: A pendulum’s swing time depends on its length, not on how far it swings.

ideas.title: Gravity’s part
ideas.oneLine: A stronger pull makes the same pendulum swing faster.

ideas.title: Small swings and big swings
ideas.oneLine: Why the size of the swing barely matters, until it does.

ideas.title: Energy back and forth
ideas.oneLine: Height turns into speed and back again on every swing.

ideas.title: From pendulums to clocks
ideas.oneLine: Who turned a swinging weight into a clock, and why that is still argued over.
